events.title: The Kaperfahrt demo is live
events.summary: The demo is out. You can download it right now from the Kaperfahrt store page and set sail in the Caribbean. This closes the playtest. Thank you to everyone who took part in the first wave, reported bugs and told me what worked and what did not. A lot of that went straight back into the build you are playing now. events.title: The first playtest wave goes out on Friday
events.summary: The first build goes out on Friday, August 28, around 6 PM CEST. As mentioned when signups opened, players come in in small waves rather than all at once, so if you are not in the first group you have not been forgotten. The waves grow as the build earns it. What you get is an early work in progress version of the open Caribbean. 200 AI captains sail, trade and fight on their own, whether you join them or not. events.title: The Caribbean is open
events.summary: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46261713/1d9ab0012f423988942d8660b80fafbc1d618c9e.jpg The store page for Kaperfahrt is live, and the playtest has started. The game that never got its successor Kleinod is a one person studio from Germany, and the idea behind it is simple. Some games from childhood never got the successor they deserved.
